A standard Island problem 3 follow-up questions based on the same problem .Detailed discussion on my current project .In-depth questions on my tech stack was Java, Spring Boot,Angular.

Be extremely clear about what you work on daily. Interviewers go very deep into your project, architecture, and decisions. Strong fundamentals are non-negotiable.

Round 2 — Technical Interview
Within a week, I got a positive response and was scheduled for Round 2.

Questions included:

A problem similar to Anagrams
A Priority Queue / Heap-based problem

We explored multiple approaches, and it turned into a very productive technical discussion.

Additional Topics: SQL, Java (deep dive),Spring Boot, a little bit of Python

Round 3 — HR / Managerial Round

The interviewer started with introductions and then moved to:One Java Based Question to code and then .One logical puzzle
